caption: Sign up asks for name, company, location, a yearly travel budget in USD, role and a password. There is no card or phone field. The e-mail shown is a placeholder.

Amsterdam to London, 10 to 11 December: 441 results, and anything from EUR 654 is flagged out of policy. BA 431 starts at EUR 160 and its EUR 450 Club Plus fare carries the out of policy mark. Nothing was booked.
The policy behind that flag: a EUR 654 maximum for this search and Economy as the highest cabin. Out of policy bookings go to a manager or travel approver, who may cancel them.
The admin Pricing page confirms the free deal: unlimited trips with $0 trip fees on a monthly term, only for companies with 300 or fewer employees.
The admin side has policy menus per travel type, from flights and trains to hotels, rental cars and black cars. All spend figures are still at zero after our test.
